patterns.note: The hero section features a full-bleed, dynamic background composed of a grid of project mockups, overlaid with very large, partially obscured text that scales and reveals more content on scroll.

The initial hero text and background grid scale down and parallax significantly as the user scrolls, transitioning from an immersive full-screen view to revealing the main content below. Sections below the hero appear to fade in or slide up with a subtle delay as they enter the viewport.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings contrasting with smaller, legible body text, and occasional use of a monospaced font for subtle labels or metadata.
The site predominantly uses a dark mode aesthetic with a very dark grey background and crisp white text, creating high contrast and a sophisticated feel with minimal use of accent colors.

Content sections frequently employ an asymmetrical two-column layout, often pairing a large image or visual element with a concise block of text, creating visual interest and clear content separation.

technique_notes: The immersive hero experience is built using a combination of a video or animated background and large, layered text elements that scale and parallax in response to scroll depth, likely managed by a scroll-triggering library like locomotive-scroll. This creates a 'peeling back' effect to reveal the main content.

Scroll-triggered animations are used throughout the page to reveal content sections. As sections enter the viewport, they animate into place with subtle fade-in and upward slide effects, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye. The sticky navigation also transforms from a full menu to a compact version after the initial scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create a strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller monospaced accents.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and section breaks, with balanced density in content blocks and a clear vertical rhythm.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its highly dynamic and immersive hero section, where large, layered text and a grid of mockups scale and parallax dramatically on scroll, creating a 'peeling back' effect that immediately draws the user in. This, combined with a sophisticated dark mode and strong typography, elevates it beyond a typical agency site.
